subject: Post-call: POC plan + prompt dataset request
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-15T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: POC plan + prompt dataset request

Hi Alex  great talking earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Goal: 4-week POC to validate improved answer relevance and latency on your customer support routing use case.
- Success criteria (proposal): 1) >= 8% relative improvement in first-contact resolution for routed tickets vs baseline; 2) median generation latency <= 350ms at 50% load; 3) no PII leakage in outputs and adherence to your retention policy.
- Deliverables we need from Acme for evaluation: sample prompt set + historical logs (anonymized) representing ~500-1,000 user prompts and expected/acceptable outputs or labels where available. Please include mapping to intents/tags if possible.
- Timeline: propose kickoff next Tue (2027-04-20), data ingestion + model config 1 week, evaluation run 2 weeks, review + wrap 1 week.
- Owners: Alex (Acme) + Marissa (Redwood) for commercial cadence; Dev (Redwood SE) for data ingestion/config.

I've attached a simple template (poc_prompt_template.csv) to make it easy to drop in prompts and metadata. Two asks for you: 1) share the sample dataset (JSONL/CSV) and any privacy constraints we should apply; 2) confirm the POC kickoff date and who from your side will attend the technical kickoff.

Thanks  talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachment: poc_prompt_template.csv (CSV template for prompt + expected label + intent)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tara Nguyen <tara.nguyen@acmecorp.com>, procurement@acmecorp.com
Date: 2027-04-16T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: POC plan + prompt dataset request

Thanks Marissa  good summary. We're aligned on the goals. Quick responses inline:

- Success criteria: Confirmed. We'll provide our baseline metrics for first-contact resolution and current latency numbers before kickoff.
- Data: Attached a small subset to start: acme_prompt_samples.jsonl (~600 records) and a logs subset (acme_logs_subset.csv) with anonymized ticket IDs. The JSONL has fields: prompt, intent_label (when available), expected_snippet. We redacted PII but note some prompts reference account nicknames  see notes in the CSV.
- Timeline: Kickoff on Tue 2027-04-20 works for us. Technical attendees: Alex (me), Tara (Product), plus our infra lead (cc'd to procurement).
- Security/privacy: we have a short internal policy: data must be retained for the POC duration only; exports beyond the POC require sign-off. We'll need confirmation of data handling and deletion process.

Next steps: I'll upload the full sample to the Drive link you shared and grant access to marissa@redwood.com and dev@redwood.com.

Best,

From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-16T12:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: POC plan + prompt dataset request  technical clarifications

Thanks Alex  saw the attachments, appreciate the quick turnaround. A few technical clarifications to make ingestion and eval reproducible:

1) File format: JSONL is ideal. Please ensure each record has a unique id field (ticket_id or prompt_id) we can use to map back.
2) Labels: If you have expected_snippet or intent_label, include them as separate fields; if not available, we can run an annotation pass but that will add time.
3) Variations: Include both raw user text and any preprocessed (e.g., stripped signatures) if you have them  we want to mirror production inputs.
4) Sensitive fields: if any fields contain account identifiers, please provide a mapping file (token->pseudo id) or confirm we should hash them on ingest.

Proposed evaluation plan (technical):
- Data ingest and schema validation (2 business days)
- Build baseline run on your provided prompts (3 business days)
- Run model variants & produce eval metrics + error analysis (5 business days)
- Joint review and plan next steps (1 business day)

I'll take ownership of ingestion and baseline runs. Rishi, can you confirm we'll allocate the dedicated test GPU from Dedicated pool for the heavier evals?

Thanks  I'll prepare a short runbook and share before kickoff.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: POC plan + prompt dataset request

Alex  thanks for the files and the timeline confirmation. A few quick updates on our side: 

- We've scheduled the technical kickoff for Tue 2027-04-20 at 10:00am PT. Calendar invite is being sent to the attendees you listed.
- Dev will own ingestion and baseline; I'll drive commercial updates and coordinate procurement if there are any contract items to surface. Rishi will oversee capacity for the heavier evals.
- I'll upload the poc_prompt_template.csv to the Drive folder and paste it below for easy reference  please use it to map any missing fields. If you prefer, just drop the JSONL into the Drive folder and we can transform it on our side.

Next steps for Alex/Tara:
1) Confirm Drive access for marissa@redwood.com and dev@redwood.com (you mentioned you'd grant).
2) Share any required NDA/procurement contacts (if procurement@acmecorp.com needs to be looped for paperwork).
3) Confirm any retention/deletion wording you require (we'll include a short section in the POC SOW).

Looking forward to kickoff.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
